metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow stole that 1 clueless kill? Valorant logic exploded
metadata.description:
Just wildly mashing buttons like my mouse had a mind of its own.
Enemy probably questioning if they blinked or got hacked.
Did NOT deserve that kill but hey, chaos picked me today.
If your aim’s more accident than skill, this one’s for you.

Tap if your aim’s a glorious mess too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
